list.title: Stores
list.reloadNeededHelp: The scraper uses an older version of this config or has not loaded it. Reload it to use the saved version.

page.summary_one: Last scan {{lastScan}} · {{products}} product in the last full crawl
page.summary_other: Last scan {{lastScan}} · {{products}} products in the last full crawl
page.scanLogHelp: Log every page the scans of this store visit. Turn it on while fixing the store, it adds many lines to the log. Scans that are running keep the setting they started with.
page.alreadyQueued: A scan of this store is already queued or running

reload.storeReloaded: Config reloaded, scans use it from now on
reload.storeFailed: The config did not load, the scraper keeps the version it loaded before: {{error}}
reload.allFailed: Some configs did not load, they keep the version loaded before: {{error}}
reload.notPickedUp: The scraper has not picked up the reload. It reloads when it is back online, check the dashboard.
reload.loadedAt: The scraper loaded this config {{time}} at {{commit}}
reload.notLoaded: The scraper has not loaded this config
reload.outdated: The scraper uses an older version of this config. Reload it to use the saved version in scans.
reload.notLoadedYet: The scraper has not loaded this config. Reload it to scan the store.

editor.noConfigFile: This store has no config file yet, saving creates it.
editor.fixSyntax: Fix the syntax errors before switching to the form
editor.committed: Committed. Reload the config so the scraper uses it.

history.restored: Config restored. Reload the config so the scraper uses it.
history.restoreConfirm: Commit this version of the config as a new change?
history.noDiff: GitHub does not show the change, the diff may be too large.
history.legacy: Changes made before the configs were split into one file per store are in the <link>history of crawler/storeConfigs.ts</link>.

tester.title: Test on a product page
tester.help: The scraper loads the page with the config as it is now, saved or not, and shows what it finds. Nothing is written to the database.
tester.fixConfigFirst: Fix the config errors before testing
tester.scraping: Scraping the page, the browser type can take up to a minute…
tester.notPickedUp: The scraper has not picked up the test. Check that it is online on the dashboard.
tester.notProductPage: Not recognised as a product page
tester.notProductPageHelp: The product container was not found or the product page identifier is not in the page source.

wizard.title: Add a store
wizard.name: Store name
wizard.nameHelp: Shown in search results and on the price chart
wizard.nameRequired: Enter the name of the store
wizard.structuredTip: With structured data on, many stores only need the product container. Test on the last step and add CSS selectors for the fields that are missing.
wizard.fixErrors: Fix these before creating the store
wizard.commitInfo: The config is committed to the scraper repository as your change, and can be edited later.
wizard.configSaveFailed: The store was created but saving its config failed. Save it again from the config tab.
wizard.existingFound: A config for store {{storeId}} is already committed
wizard.existingInvalid: It has problems. Fix them in the scraper repository and check again:
wizard.usingExisting: The store gets id {{storeId}} and uses the committed config
wizard.existingCommitInfo: The store uses the config that is already committed, nothing is committed now. It can be edited later on the config tab.

configForm.startUrlHelp: The crawl starts here and only follows links on this site.
configForm.startUrlRequired: Enter the url of the store
configForm.startUrlInvalid: Enter a full url, e.g. https://example.is
configForm.plainHtmlHelp: fast, use this when the product data is in the page source
configForm.browserHelp: slow, for stores that render products with JavaScript
configForm.identifierHelp: Text that is only in the source of product pages. Most stores have JSON-LD, try <compact/> or <spaced/>.
configForm.identifierRequired: Enter text that identifies product pages
configForm.whitelistHelp: Leave empty to follow every link on the site. Type a path and press enter, e.g. /vorur
configForm.blacklistHelp: Pages that are not products, e.g. /blogg, /um-okkur, /karfa
configForm.queryParamsHelp: Parameters are removed from links before they are crawled, e.g. filters and sorting that only repeat the products of a category page.
configForm.keepQueryParamsHelp: Type a parameter name and press enter, e.g. page
configForm.keepQueryParamsRequired: Add a parameter, or choose Remove all
configForm.startUrlsHelp: The crawl starts from these too, e.g. a product listing with a larger page size than the site links to.
configForm.sitemapsHelp: Product urls in these sitemaps are crawled too. Useful when category pages do not link to every product.
configForm.maxRequestsPerMinuteHelp: How many pages a scan of the store requests a minute, 60 when empty. Raise it only for a site that handles it, lower it for a site that answers with 429 or 503.
configForm.productFeedHelp: A JSON endpoint that lists the products, for stores whose category pages load them with JavaScript. The product page of each item is crawled.
configForm.feedUrlHelp: Absolute or relative to the start url. May hold {page} for a paged feed and {field} placeholders of the feed list items.
configForm.feedItemsHelp: Dot path to the list of products, a JSON string on the way is parsed, e.g. "d.data".
configForm.feedProductUrlHelp: {field} is replaced with that field of the item, {field:5} pads it with zeros to 5 characters, e.g. /vara?id={ProductID}
configForm.feedPageCountHelp: For a paged feed: dot path to the number of pages in each response, e.g. "pageCount". {page} in the feed url is replaced with each page number, starting at 1.
configForm.feedListUrlHelp: Reads the feed once per item of this JSON list, e.g. once per category. {field} in the feed url is replaced with that field of each item, e.g. /api/categories/{slug}/products?page={page}
configForm.feedListItemsHelp: Dot path to the list in the feed list response, empty when the response is the list.
configForm.scroll: Scroll to the bottom of pages
configForm.scrollHelp: For stores that load more products while scrolling.
configForm.menuButtonHelp: Clicked on the start page to open a menu that holds the category links.
configForm.structuredDataHelp: Reads the product from data embedded in the page, which changes less often than the page layout. CSS selectors below fill in what is missing.
configForm.fieldOverridesHelp: Read a field from other dot paths (relative to the Product for JSON-LD, to the root for Next.js data), or skip it to use the CSS selector instead.
configForm.categorySeparatorHelp: When categories are one string, e.g. "|" for Snyrtivara|Förðun|Varir
configForm.selectorsHelp: CSS selectors relative to the product container.
configForm.selectorsHelpBrowser: Playwright selectors such as :has-text("kr.") work too.
configForm.selectorsHelpHtml: Cheerio selectors such as :contains("kr.") work too.
configForm.selectorsHelpSkip: Leave a field empty to skip it.
configForm.productContainerHelp: The element holding the product, e.g. main or #product
configForm.name: Name
configForm.priceOptional: Optional when structured data has the price
configForm.oldPriceHelp: Only shown when the product is on sale
configForm.skuJsonHelp: Searched in the whole page, e.g. a <script> holding the product as JSON
configForm.skuOptional: Optional when structured data has the sku
configForm.jsonPathHelp: Dot path to the value, e.g. id or variants.0.sku
configForm.imageAttributeHelp: Defaults to src, e.g. data-src for lazy loaded images
configForm.inStockTextHelp: Text of the stock status that means the product is in stock
configForm.categoryItemHelp: Each item in it, e.g. li
configForm.clickersHelp: Selectors of tabs or buttons that reveal the description or specifications
configForm.specificationsHelp: The table of product attributes, e.g. size, weight and color.
configForm.groupHelp: Optional, when the table has sections
configForm.sanitizersHelp: Replacements applied to the SKU in order, e.g. remove a "Vörunúmer:" prefix.

validation.url: {{path}} must be an absolute http(s) url
validation.skuIndex: {{path}} must be a number, first or last
validation.integerRange: {{path}} must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
validation.sku: {{path}} must be a CSS selector or an object with source url, attribute or json
validation.structuredDataField: {{path}} must be a path, a list of paths or false
validation.productUrlField: {{path}} must hold a {field} of the items
validation.feedPagePlaceholder: {{path}} must hold {page} when productFeed.pageCount is set
validation.feedListField: {{path}} must hold a {field} of the feed list items
validation.listPriceStructured: {{path}} is required unless the price comes from structured data
